title: The machines that are also traps
target: What a blender, a gumball machine, a traffic light and a tray do when they go off in R.E.P.O., and what each of them tells you before it does.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A level with the machine valuables still standing
A crew that will not crowd a machine while it is working
A way to leave a valuable behind if it starts up

steps.do: Treat a blender, a gumball machine, a traffic light and a tray as one kind of thing: a valuable that is also a machine.
steps.because: each carries the trap state of triggered, active and started, the switch for triggering on a timer and the rarity level at which it goes off (trapTriggered, trapActive, trapStart, triggerOnTimer, trapActivateRarityLevel)

steps.do: Do not reach into a blender for the money, because it has blades of its own.
steps.because: it has a timer of its own and blades with a speed and a curve (blenderTimer, blade, bladeSpeed, bladeCurve)

steps.do: Listen to a blender, because it says what it is doing.
steps.because: it has separate sounds for the blades starting, looping and ending, plus a loop for being stuck and one for an empty jug (soundBladeStart, soundBladeLoop, soundBladeEnd, soundBladeStuckLoop, soundBladeEmptyLoop)

steps.do: Expect a blender to throw what is inside it.
steps.because: it has a bill soup with a curve of its own, a cap that pops with a collider, and particles for the bills, dust and the cap (billSoup, billSoupCurve, capPop, capCollider, billParticles, dustParticles)

steps.do: Look away from the gumball machine rather than at it.
steps.because: it works on the player with a vignette, a screen spiral, camera zoom speeds and an amount, and it takes aim away (vignetteIntensity, screenSpiralEffect, cameraZoomSpeedIn, cameraZoomAmount, noAimStrength)

steps.do: Watch its lids and its eye, because the eye is what does the work.
steps.because: it has meshes for its lids closed and open, an eyeball of its own and a globe, and the eye has a lock transform and a line of its own (closedLidsMesh, openLidsMesh, eyeBallMesh, eyeLockTransform, hypnosisLine)

steps.do: Read a traffic light as a countdown rather than as a signal to cross.
steps.because: each colour has a length of time of its own and red lingers after the others (redLightDuration, greenLightDuration, yellowLightDuration, lingerOnRedTime)

steps.do: Expect a traffic light's zap to be both loud and physical.
steps.because: zapping shakes the camera with a length, a strength and bounds, has sparks, smoke and a zap particle of its own, and the light torques and tumbles (cameraShakeTime, sparkParticles, smokeParticles, zapParticles, SelfTorqueMultiplier, tumbleForceMultiplier)

steps.do: Count what is standing on a tray before you move it.
steps.because: what stands on the tray is kept as a group of its own, with particles and colliders for those things (trayThings, trayParticles, trayColliders)

commonMistakes: Putting a hand into a blender that is still running.
Meeting the gumball machine's eye instead of turning away.
Crossing in front of a traffic light while its red is lingering.
Lifting a tray and losing what was standing on it.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
